parent.unconditional_disposition: REJECT learned HOLD/EXIT threshold 0.50 as a stable unconditional replacement for ATR trailing; retain threshold 0.50 only as the fixed specialist candidate

objective: test whether the fixed learned HOLD/EXIT policy has chronology-transportable value only in causally identifiable decision-time states while ATR trailing remains the default elsewhere

base_exit_policies.specialist: existing learned HOLD/EXIT policy at probability threshold 0.50 from #19

meta_target: learned_realized_points_minus_atr_trailing_realized_points for an already-completed parent OOS decision

meta_model.prediction_rule: fit only on earlier parent-OOS decisions whose target_resolution_row is strictly less than the current decision_row; predict incremental learned-minus-ATR value from current decision-time regime flags

secondary_context: activation counts by year and each frozen regime flag

required: hybrid-minus-ATR annual mean positive in at least 4 of 6 full years 2020-2025
median of the six full-year hybrid-minus-ATR means > 0
at least 1000 OOS decisions select the learned specialist after meta support begins
at least 4 of 6 full years contain at least 100 specialist-selected decisions
no single full year contributes more than 50% of the sum of positive full-year hybrid-minus-ATR points
development_gate.failure_rule: do not select favorable years, regimes, activation thresholds, learned thresholds, model alphas, features, sessions, or volatility/trend/liquidity states from these outcomes

confirmation_boundary.next_confirmation_if_pass: separately frozen unconsumed NQ or genuinely prospective MNQ block; do not reuse 2022, 2025, 2026, AXB, or other previously consumed MNQ slices as fresh confirmation
